info.title: Background File Mover - partial contract candidate
info.description: NOT FROZEN. Partial producer/session/retry wire candidate; not an implemented API or complete release surface. See README.md. Do not generate production clients from this draft.

x-freeze-blockers: Route inventory and exact read schemas
Bulk retry receipt retention, duplicate/no-acceptance outcome policy and transaction design; concrete candidate header/bounds now supplied
Group50 safe full unlinking of service records (not physical files), clear/delete serialization and pre-clear asynchronous counts
Global UUID stored-state migration and no-clobber reuse
Manifest numeric encoding and legacy compatibility
Remote proxy and session CSRF/inactivity boundary details

post.description: 202 only after complete durable source custody; identical confirmed replay remains 202. No destination completion claim. Producer-only protected boundary.

202.description: Complete durable custody / authorized identical replay

default.description: Mover-generated producer error; transport/proxy failures may lack this JSON

200.description: Authenticated; Set-Cookie establishes proposed opaque server session

Set-Cookie.description: __Host-mover_admin=<opaque>; Secure; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Strict. No Domain or persistent expiry. Candidate only.

Mover-CSRF-Token.description: Candidate opaque session-bound CSRF token; only returned after login or authorized session read. No token in JSON.

Cache-Control.description: Authentication material must not be cached.

403.description: Candidate admin_request_forbidden: Origin/CSRF boundary failed; no job/session-activity effect.

post.x-csrf-defense: Candidate specified in ACCESS-BOUNDARY.candidate.md: exact Origin; protected mutations require session cookie AND session-bound Mover-CSRF-Token. Not implemented/frozen.

parameters.description: Candidate exact configured HTTPS dashboard origin; reject missing, null, multiple or mismatching values. Never infer the trusted origin from an untrusted forwarded header.

Mover-CSRF-Token.description: Candidate opaque session-bound CSRF token; only returned after login or authorized session read. No token in JSON.

403.description: Candidate admin_request_forbidden when a marked read fails CSRF, target-authority or supplied Origin/Fetch-Metadata checks. Missing Origin alone is allowed on GET; do not renew rejected activity.

get.x-inactivity-policy: Background reads do not renew. Deliberate Mover-Admin-Activity: interaction requires session-bound CSRF and the configured target authority. Origin is optional on GET, but must match when supplied. Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin when supplied. See ACCESS-BOUNDARY.candidate.md.

parameters.name: Mover-Admin-Activity
parameters.description: Candidate deliberate read/navigation only. Omit for polling. If supplied, valid session-bound CSRF and configured target authority are mandatory. Do not require a script-supplied Origin for same-origin browser GET.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Browsers normally omit Origin on same-origin GET. Optional here; if supplied it must exactly match the configured dashboard origin.

parameters.name: Mover-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required and session-bound when deliberate activity is asserted; not required for an ordinary nonrenewing session read.

parameters.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
parameters.description: Browser-supplied metadata. If present on a deliberate-activity read it must be same-origin; absence does not remove the mandatory session-bound CSRF check.

post.description: Candidate only. Group49 approves header transport; exact name/encoding and remaining outcome policies are proposals. Validate frozen context then replay stored occurrence outcomes before new eligibility. No new user confirmation or job identifier.

parameters.name: Mover-Retry-Context
parameters.description: v1. plus canonical unpadded base64url of the fixed-key decoded RetryContextDecoded object. 6144-byte value, 4096-byte decoded payload; aggregate raw head8192 unchanged. Existing instance and ordered selection binding required.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Candidate exact configured HTTPS dashboard origin; reject missing, null, multiple or mismatching values. Never infer the trusted origin from an untrusted forwarded header.

202.description: Approved groups 45/51: valid completed retry batches return 202 even with zero accepted attempts, with actual accepted/failed/skipped occurrence counts. Scheduling acceptance is not transfer completion. Whole-request validation/storage failures remain errors.

400.description: Candidate invalid_retry_context for malformed/missing/duplicate/invalid context or selection disagreement; body envelope still to freeze.

401.description: Missing/expired/revoked admin session; no receipt disclosure.

409.description: Candidate review_conflict for wrong mover instance; per-occurrence stale epochs/count policy remains separate.

431.description: Aggregate head, encoded context or decoded context bound exceeded; no effects. Candidate request_headers_too_large code/body to finalize.

503.description: Storage/queue failure; no fabricated final counts. Preserve original context for retry; prior transactions may have committed.

403.description: Candidate admin_request_forbidden: Origin/CSRF boundary failed; no job/session-activity effect.

post.x-csrf-defense: Candidate specified in ACCESS-BOUNDARY.candidate.md: exact Origin; protected mutations require session cookie AND session-bound Mover-CSRF-Token. Not implemented/frozen.
x-pending: Partial transaction/storage outcomes; group50 clears that job records/receipts without affecting uncleared-job replay
Exact admin error response envelope and CSRF/read integration
x-approved-group-51: After the first eligible duplicate schedules work, the next occurrence counts failed.
Exact transport replay preserves original outcomes for uncleared jobs and never releases a later review.
History clear removes only that job's receipts/linkage, without erasing uncleared-job replay.

producerMutualTLS.description: External protected producer ingress; TLS rejection may have no HTTP response. Not implemented.

adminCookie.name: __Host-mover_admin
adminCookie.description: Proposed opaque server-side dashboard session. CSRF defense remains mandatory; this scheme alone is incomplete.

adminCsrfHeader.name: Mover-CSRF-Token
adminCsrfHeader.description: Candidate session-bound CSRF token; requires valid adminCookie and exact configured Origin. Not a retry review context or file-selection confirmation.

x-history-clear-policy: Group50: cleared jobs have no remaining mover file linkage or results. Leave files unchanged; require all associated effects stopped/settled before clear.
